sections.title: A Search for Potency
sections.body:
Apothecary Lydon needs a fresh sample of the stronger venom. The broodguard venom you brought was weaker than your first sample, so it must come from another kind of spider.

Lydon sends you to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village, in Durotar. Gadrin is a troll well acquainted with the Witherbark, and may know where the venom comes from.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon send you to Master Gadrin?
faq.answer: The broodguard venom was weaker than your first sample, which points to another kind of spider. Master Gadrin knows the Witherbark and may name the venom's source.
Master Gadrin is in Sen'jin Village, in Durotar.
Before this journey, you brought Apothecary Lydon an undamaged venom sac from the Hinterlands.
